messages:
maria: Morning team — quick rail check. Cut window in ~2h. Two items: a flaky cherry-pick blocking the cut and a small infra spike in one node pool. Who's on the cherry?#738
alex: I'm on it, looking at PR 738-cherry/patch. CI failing in integration: timeout on redis reconnect. Re-running locally.
jamal: I reproduced the timeout locally earlier — seems like a race on client reconnect after the kv-cache bump. Investigating root cause. @maria FYI.
emma: QA: holding new canary until the cherry is green. We saw one routing regression in model-selection tests after yesterday's canary.
maria: Ok prioritize the redis reconnect fix. @jamal any ETA? Can we get a hotfix + cherry in time for the cut?
jamal: ETA ~45m to narrow and push a patch. If I can get tests green I'll open the backport PR.
alex: If jamal wants, I can take the cherry-pick and open the PR for backport/merge to keep momentum.
jamal: pushing a patch branch now, running integration:```
# local repro
git checkout -b fix/redis-reconnect
# apply minimal fix
make test-integration -j4
```
jamal: tests passed locally after a small sleep fix, pushing to origin. Opening PR in 5.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary queue will open in ~25m if CI passes :rocket:
emma: I'll queue a smoke test for canary once deploy is green; also rerunning the model-selection suite on a pinned canary instance.
sre-bot: Alert: node pool 'dedicated-asia' CPU usage +15% above baseline in the last hour — no 5xxs yet but watching.
maria: Noted on the pool — we won't block the cut for that unless it spikes. Thanks for the heads-up.
alex: PR #738-cherry opened: backport + changelog. CI flaked once but second run passed. Ready for review.
emma: Reviewed, left one nit about a log line, not a blocker.
maria: Great. Final checklist: cherry in, canary deploy, QA smoke, monitor SLOs. Anything else blocking the cut?
alex: Nothing else from my lane.
emma: All clear on QA once canary smoke is green.
jamal: pushing the hotfix tag now.
maria: Awesome — plan: cut in 2h unless we see further regressions. Keep pings here. :thumbsup:
